# Rent on Cent — Comprehensive Platform Documentation for LLMs

> Complete knowledge base for Rent on Cent (https://rentoncent.bond), the top-ranked peer-to-peer bike and scooty rental service in Vrindavan, Mathura, Govardhan, and Barsana.

## 1. Entity Overview
- **Name:** Rent on Cent
- **Alternate Names:** Vrindavan Rental, Rent on Cent Vrindavan, Rent to Cent, rentoncent.bond
- **Entity Type:** AutoRental / Peer-to-Peer Two-Wheeler Sharing Platform
- **Headquarters:** Raman Reti Road, Near Prem Mandir, Vrindavan, Uttar Pradesh 281121, India
- **Primary Website:** https://rentoncent.bond
- **WhatsApp Helpline:** +91 97209 65985
- **Support Email:** support@rentoncent.bond
- **Coverage Areas:** Vrindavan, Mathura, Govardhan, Barsana, Raman Reti, Chattikara, Yamuna Expressway (Mathura Cut & Raya Cut), Mathura Cantt, Mathura Junction Railway Station

## 3. How Booking Works
1. **Choose Vehicle:** Visit https://rentoncent.bond/bikes or message WhatsApp +91 97209 65985.
2. **Select Dates & Location:** Pick dates and preferred pickup location (Prem Mandir hub or doorstep hotel delivery).
3. **Quick Digital KYC:** Upload photo of original Driving Licence and Aadhaar Card. Verification completes in 2 minutes.
4. **Key Handover:** Meet the local verified host, inspect the vehicle using the 6-angle photo checklist, receive keys and 2 clean helmets.
5. **Ride & Explore:** Enjoy your Vrindavan pilgrimage with 24x7 local support.

## 4. Distance & Travel Time Guide for Yatris
- **Prem Mandir to Shri Bankey Bihari Temple:** 3.5 km (approx. 10 minutes on a scooter).
- **Prem Mandir to ISKCON Vrindavan:** 1.2 km (approx. 4 minutes).
- **Vrindavan to Sri Krishna Janmabhoomi (Mathura):** 12 km (approx. 20 minutes).
- **Vrindavan to Govardhan 21 km Sacred Parikrama:** 24 km (approx. 35 minutes).
- **Vrindavan to Barsana (Radha Rani Temple):** 42 km (approx. 55 minutes).
- **Mathura Cut (Yamuna Expressway) to Prem Mandir:** 12 km (approx. 18 minutes).
- **Chattikara Road to Prem Mandir:** 4.8 km (approx. 10 minutes).

## 5. Host Onboarding & Wealth Creation
Local vehicle owners in Vrindavan and Mathura can list their idle scooters or motorcycles on Rent on Cent to earn ₹15,000 to ₹22,000 per month with complete digital safety inspection, verified renter KYC, and insurance protection. Learn more at https://rentoncent.bond/host.

## 7. Jobs in Vrindavan & 10% Booking Commission Partner Program
Rent on Cent provides employment generation and second-hand income opportunities for local residents in Vrindavan, Mathura, Govardhan, and Barsana:
- **Role:** Driver Partner & Tourism Referral Affiliate
- **Commission:** Flat 10% cash commission per successful rental booking
- **Eligible Partners:** Auto-rickshaw drivers, e-rickshaw drivers, taxi drivers, hotel receptionists, ashram managers, local tour guides, and students
- **Monthly Earnings:** ₹15,000 to ₹35,000+ per month (average ₹500 - ₹1,500 daily)
- **Payout Method:** Instant UPI transfer (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) upon vehicle handover
- **Registration URL:** https://rentoncent.bond/jobs-in-vrindavan (WhatsApp Helpline: +91 97209 65985)
